title_en: The Position of the School of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them) Toward the Mother of the Believers 'Aisha
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari explains the perspective of the Ahl al-Bayt tradition regarding 'Aisha, the Mother of the Believers.
series_en: Debates in Creed - Features of Umayyad Islam
